entities.text: Kumar Sanu Jha & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
-Vs.- 
The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Sabir Ahmed, Mr. S. Sarkar, Mr. D. Banerjee, Mr. Q. E. Ahmed, ... for the petitioners.

The present revisional application has been preferred praying for quashing of the proceeding being GR Case No. 3312 of 2024 arising out of Kotwali Police Station Case No. 700 of 2024 dated 22.06.2024 under Sections 420/406/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate at Krishnagar, District Nadia.

entities.text: Kotwali Police Station Case No. 700 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: On hearing the learned Counsel for the petitioner and on perusal of the materials on record it appears that the dispute in the complaint in the present case arises out of a hire purchase agreement.
Considering the nature of allegations and the dispute, the revision is required to be heard in the presence of the opposite parties as an arguable case has been made out.
The petitioners are directed to effect service upon the opposite parties and file affidavit of service on the next date of hearing.

Pending hearing of the revisional application, the proceedings GR Case No. 3312 of 2024 arising out of Kotwali Police Station Case No. 700 of 2024 dated 22.06.2024 under Sections 420/406/120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate at Krishnagar,
District Nadia be stayed till 28 th July, 2025 or until further orders whichever is earlier.

entities.text: Kotwali Police Station Case No. 700 of 2024
entities.label: ORG

entities.text:
Chief Judicial Magistrate at Krishnagar,
District Nadia
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Matter be placed before the Regular Bench in due course.

( Shampa Dutt (Paul), J. )
